teaser.en: Its papery green bark peels like old paint, and its fragrant resin is chewed, carved into, and used on arrows.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la kijani kama karatasi hubanduka kama rangi kuukuu, na utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri hutafunwa, huchongwa, na hutumika kwenye mishale.
teaser.dg: Gophare ra chijani rinaanduka dza karatasi, dza rangi ya kare inavyoanduka, na ulimbowe wenye arufu nono nkuafunwa, nkutsongwa na nkuhumirwa kpwenye mivwi.

summary.en: *Mbambara* is the African myrrh, a spiny dry-bush shrub with peeling bark and fragrant resin. Its resin, fruit, roots and wood all have uses, from chewing and medicine to spoons and toothbrushes.
summary.sw: *Mbambara* (kwa Kiingereza *African myrrh*) ni kichaka chenye miiba cha vichaka vikavu, chenye gome linalobanduka na utomvu wenye harufu nzuri. Utomvu, matunda, mizizi na mbao zake vyote vina matumizi, kuanzia kutafuna na dawa hadi miiko na miswaki.
summary.dg: *Mbambara* (kpwa Chingereza *African myrrh*) ni chitsaka cha weruni mkavu chenye miya, gopha rinaroanduka na ulimbo wenye arufu nono. Ulimbowe, matundage, miziye na nyama za muhi vyosi vina kazi, kula kuafunwa na dawa hadi kuhenda vidziko na misuwaki.

about.en: *Mbambara* is a spiny shrub whose bark peels away in papery flakes to show green beneath. Cut it and a fragrant, resinous sap oozes out, the mark of the myrrh family. Each leaf has three hairy leaflets, and the leaves often drop in the dry season, leaving a grey, spiny skeleton. The small flowers are red.
about.sw: *Mbambara* ni kichaka chenye miiba ambacho gome lake hubanduka kwa vipande vyembamba kama karatasi na kuonyesha rangi ya kijani chini yake. Ukikikata, utomvu wenye harufu nzuri hutoka, alama ya familia ya manemane. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vyenye vinyweleo, na mara nyingi majani hupukutika wakati wa kiangazi, yakiacha kiunzi cha kijivu chenye miiba. Maua yake madogo ni mekundu.
about.dg: *Mbambara* ni chitsaka chenye miya, ambacho gophare rinaanduka vipande vyembamba dza karatasi na photsi kunaonekana rangi ya chijani. Uchichenya gopha, maziya genye arufu nono dza ulimbo ganatuluka, ndiyo alama ya jamii ya *myrrh*. Chila kodza rina makodza madide matahu genye nyere. Mara nyinji makodza ganagbwa wakati wa kazikazi, na kunasala mifupha ya rangi ya ivu yenye miya. Maruwage madide ni ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, in the drier country away from the moist coast.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, katika maeneo makavu zaidi yaliyo mbali na pwani yenye unyevu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni mkavu, kpwenye tsi kavu iriyo kure na pwani yenye jeke-jeke.

uses.en: The resin is chewed and is also used in arrow-making. The fruit and young roots are eaten. The soft wood is carved, notably into spoons, and twigs serve as toothbrushes. The plant is also used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Utomvu wake hutafunwa na pia hutumika katika kutengeneza mishale. Matunda na mizizi michanga huliwa. Mbao zake laini huchongwa, hasa kuwa miiko, na vitawi hutumika kama miswaki. Mmea huu pia hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji.
uses.dg: Ulimbo nkuafunwa na piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda mivwi. Matunda na mizi midide nkuriwa. Nyama za muhi ni laini, na nkutsongwa, hasa kuhenda vidziko, na vigongo nkuhumirwa dza misuwaki. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: Pakia records *mbambara*; ICRAF's handbook and the Mgombato dictionary give *chibambara*. Mgombato calls it the poison-grub commiphora and lists Swahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* and *mlororo*; Swahili also has *mturituri*. In Giriama it is *musishwi*, and in English African myrrh.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mbambara*; kitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinatoa *chibambara*. Mgombato inauita *poison-grub commiphora* na kuorodhesha majina ya Kiswahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* na *mlororo*; Kiswahili kina pia *mturituri*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *musishwi*, na kwa Kiingereza *African myrrh*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mbambara*; chitabu cha ICRAF na kamusi ya Mgombato vinapha *chibambara*. Mgombato unauiha *poison-grub commiphora* na unaandika madzina ga Chiswahili *mkororo*, *mbambara* na *mlororo*; Chiswahili piya china *mturituri*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *musishwi*, na kpwa Chingereza *African myrrh*.

reason.en: Toothbrush tree, also used for chewing sticks
reason.sw: Mswaki, nao hutumika kwa vijiti vya kutafuna
reason.dg: *Msuwaki*, piya nkuhumirwa dza vigongo vya kuafuna

reason.en: Lowveld fig, whose latex was also used for arrows
reason.sw: *Lowveld fig*, ambao utomvu wake pia ulitumika kwa mishale
reason.dg: *Uuzi kaha*, ambao maziyage piya ganahumirwa kpwa mivwi
